text: いつも　もうれつに　おこっており　にげても　にげても　どこまでも　おいかけてくる。

structure.jp: いつも　もうれつに　おこっており
structure.en: it is always furiously angry, and

structure.jp: にげても　にげても
どこまでも　おいかけてくる。
structure.en: it comes chasing after you anywhere

patterns.name: 〜ても〜ても
patterns.span: にげても　にげても
patterns.explanation: ても means 'even if', and saying the same verb twice with it means 'no matter how much you do it'. にげても にげても = 'no matter how far you run'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says a state is going on. Here it is in the written form ており, which also joins this part to the next like 'and'. おこっており = 'it is angry, and'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says the action comes toward you. おいかけてくる = 'it comes chasing after you'.
